Tentorium vibrates sympathetically → its water lattice heats and loses order (EZ fragmentation). Once EZ charge weakens, ability to dissipate wave energy collapses → structure that once absorbed turbulence now reflects and amplifies it → standing wave cavity between occipital bone, cerebellar hemispheres, and venous sinuses.
